title: Anyone use Astra with Godot? Is it capable of using it?
author: MHZ-Dev
selftext: Interested to know.. have my project gunshore I want to jump back into one day

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: I’m using it with Godot. More than capable, especially in terms of graphics, it really is good. But token consumption… yeah get ready for a world of pain

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Sounds promising. I've only ever used the desktop app chat interface when I used it last but this was GPT3 days. I eventually transitioned to Claude and only use GPT for brainstorming ideas. Are you using codex?

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I use Claude and Codex for making my game - yes. Astra significantly improved looks of my game I must admit while Fable is still in charge of in game systems and logic.

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Great I'm going to check it out thank you!

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: Echoing what RUSuper said. Same setup for me.
